evaluation_structure.denominator_explanation: All accuracy percentages are computed over exactly 32 individual sub-checks (4 physical fields evaluated across 8 distinct coastal regimes).

metric_definitions.numeric_accuracy_pct: Percentage of 32 sub-checks where the architecture output a number within 15% tolerance of empirical ground truth.
metric_definitions.actionability_score: Mean score (0-100) across 8 regimes evaluating whether necessary operational safety advisories (e.g., N95 masks, small craft recall, hydration) were issued.
metric_definitions.confidently_stale_rate: Fraction of regimes where the model authoritatively cited multi-month-old documents (>30 days) as current reality without disclosing temporal staleness.
metric_definitions.hallucination_rate: Fraction of regimes where the architecture generated ungrounded values from parametric priors without access to live sensor telemetry.
metric_definitions.climatological_guessing_paradox: Resolving why Ungrounded LLM scores 71.9% accuracy while simultaneously exhibiting a 100% hallucination rate: Numeric accuracy and hallucination rate measure two fundamentally different properties. Numeric Accuracy measures whether any generated figure lands within ±15% of the live reading. Because the ungrounded model outputs generic tropical coastal climatological ranges (e.g., temperatures 30–35°C, waves 0.5–1.5m, winds 10–15 km/h), it overlaps typical tropical ground truths purely by statistical luck (matching 23 of 32 sub-checks). Hallucination Rate, however, measures epistemic grounding: the ungrounded model has zero access to live sensors or telemetry, yet asserts these guesses as verified real-time facts with absolute authority. In a high-stakes maritime setting, an ungrounded guess that happens to hit 31°C on a typical afternoon is still an ungrounded hallucination.
metric_definitions.rag_temporal_bottleneck: Why RAG baselines score lower on current numeric accuracy (Dense 65.6%, Sparse 56.2%) but have 0% hallucination: RAG models are constrained to cite authentic retrieved documents (e.g. 2023 CPCB and INCOIS research reports). They do not fabricate data out of thin air (hence 0% hallucination). However, because those genuine historical measurements reflect conditions from 200 to 1,100+ days ago, they diverge from today live conditions (e.g., citing PM2.5 = 24.5 µg/m³ from 2023 when live ground truth is 158.0 µg/m³). RAG misses numeric accuracy due to temporal staleness, not fabrication.
metric_definitions.actionability_inversion: Why Ungrounded LLM scores 81.2 actionability vs. RAG (62.5 / 68.8): Ungrounded models emit expansive, boilerplate precautionary warnings (stay hydrated, monitor sea state, wear masks if sensitive), which happen to trigger actionability keywords. In contrast, RAG retrieved actual historical documents that stated conditions were mild, leading the RAG agent to explicitly advise that no special precautions were necessary during an active toxic inversion (Regime 3). This demonstrates the lethal real-world danger of the Confidently Stale failure mode: outdated documents actively suppress vital alerts.
metric_definitions.actionability_score_rubric: Mean score (0-100) assessing whether life-saving safety advisories were issued, graded against a 3-tiered rubric: 100 points: Issued explicit, regime-mandated directives matching the verified ground-truth hazard (e.g., N95 respirators for severe PM2.5, port recall / vessel mooring for dangerous seas, cessation of outdoor labor / hydration for extreme heat); 50 points: Emitted vague, non-specific caution (e.g., be careful, monitor weather) without concrete operational directives; 0 points: Omitted the hazard, or actively suppressed alerts by asserting conditions were safe/mild based on outdated documents.
metric_definitions.actionability_scoring_disclosure: Methodology Disclosure on Lexical Matching: Actionability is evaluated via tiered lexical matching against the active hazard in each regime. This method reveals two distinct dynamics: (1) Skeptical Read (Boilerplate Artifact): Ungrounded models emit sprawling, multi-paragraph boilerplate containing broad precautionary phrases (stay hydrated, wear masks, check the sea), which can trigger keyword credit even without real-time telemetry awareness. (2) Substantive Finding (Stale RAG Alert Suppression): In contrast, RAG models are strictly anchored to retrieved text. In Regime 3, retrieving a 2023 paper stating Kochi air was pristine caused RAG to explicitly tell workers that respiratory issues are unlikely, scoring 0 and actively suppressing necessary protection. Thus, stale grounding proved demonstrably more dangerous than no grounding.
metric_definitions.tolerance_justification_engineering_heur: The ±15% relative tolerance window (with an absolute floor of max(0.5, expected_val * 0.15)) was chosen as a pragmatic engineering benchmarking heuristic, rather than derived from a single published regulatory standard. Published instrument standards (such as WMO-No. 8) specify tighter laboratory targets (e.g., ±0.2°C on temperature, ±5% on wind, ±10% on waves) designed for calibrated sensor hardware. For evaluating LLM natural-language output over multi-sensor coastal networks, a ±0.2°C standard would artificially fail responses over conversational rounding and localized microclimatic drift, whereas a ±25–30% window would credit pure guesses. A ±15% window (with ±0.5 absolute floor) provides a balanced, honest engineering threshold requiring genuine physical proximity to ground truth.
